title: Cover Picture and Issue Information
content:
Cover image: A tower of Masai giraffes from Tarangire National Park in Tanzania showing variation in coat spot patterns among individuals. New research investigating the role of spot patterns on fitness shows that coat spot size correlates with giraffe survival during heat waves and cold spells. Full details are available in the article by Mouchet et al, https://doi.org/10.1111/1365-2664.70358.
